name: mpoint-tensor
description: Tensor glyphs at material points. Pick the tensor field: 'stress', 'strain', or 'strainrate'. Useful for visualising principal-stress orientation and magnitude across the MPM body.

sub_items.name: strain
sub_items.description: Tensor glyphs for the strain field. All display keywords live at this level, not at the item's top level, which offers only the three quantities.
verification: state -- MPoint3D 9.7, identical 13-keyword set for all three quantities

sub_items.name: strainrate
sub_items.description: Tensor glyphs for the strainrate field. All display keywords live at this level, not at the item's top level, which offers only the three quantities.
verification: state -- MPoint3D 9.7, identical 13-keyword set for all three quantities

sub_items.name: stress
sub_items.description: Tensor glyphs for the stress field. All display keywords live at this level, not at the item's top level, which offers only the three quantities.
verification: state -- MPoint3D 9.7, identical 13-keyword set for all three quantities

notes: Probe live with 'plot item create <type> ?' to list top-level keywords, then 'plot item create <type> <kw> ?' for sub-options. Do NOT probe with a bogus token: 'plot item create <type> zzbogus' creates the item and then reports 'Unused extra parameter' without ever enumerating. Keyword sets here are binary-validated against MPoint 3D 9.

The split is systematic rather than per-item: 'clip', 'cut', 'quality' and 'transparency' are 3D rendering concepts and are absent from every MPoint item type in 2D, while 'spheres' is how 2D draws point entities and appears only on the point items ('mpoint', 'mpoint-hybrid', 'meshpoint'), not the vector ones. 'mpoint-tensor' has an identical keyword set in both.

keywords.description: Draw the stress tensor glyph at each material point.
keywords.name: stress

examples.command: plot item create mpoint-tensor stress legend active on
examples.description: Principal-stress glyphs at material points. Use case: Stress tensor

examples.command: plot item create mpoint-tensor stress scale value 1.5
examples.description: 'scale' needs the 'value' keyword; a bare 'scale 1.5' is rejected. Use case: Fixed glyph size
